segments.t: In the restaurant office, little Alisa spends the day with her father, Chef Viktor Barinov. Alisa asks Viktor if she resembles him, sparking a playful conversation about her mother's teasing jokes. Listen to the conversation in Russian first, and then we will examine every line together.

Пап, смотри, я похожа на тебя?
Конечно, солнышко!

А мама говорит другое.
Она говорит, слава богу, не похожа!

Не обращай внимания.

Я самый красивый повар в Москве!

Алиса, как тебе мой ресторан?
'Alisa, how do you like my restaurant?' Viktor asks his young daughter with a proud smile.
Пап, смотри, я похожа на тебя?
'Dad, look, do I look like you?' Alisa asks her father with childlike curiosity.
Конечно, солнышко!
'Of course, sunshine!' Viktor answers her warmly with an affectionate nickname.
У тебя мои глаза и улыбка.
'You have my eyes and smile.' Chef Barinov uses the classic Russian possession phrasing — literally 'at you' rather than a verb meaning 'to have', combining 'eyes' with 'smile'.
А мама говорит другое.
'And mom says something else.' Alisa puts the word for 'mom' together with 'says' and 'something else' in a crisp, natural spoken turn of phrase.
Она говорит, слава богу, не похожа!
'She says, thank God, you do not look like him!' Alisa quotes her mother with cheerful innocence.
Это она так шутит.
'She was just joking.' Viktor reassures his daughter with a chuckle.
Не обращай внимания.
'Do not pay any attention.' Viktor dismisses the joke with a wave of his hand.
А ты тоже красивый, пап?
'Are you handsome too, Dad?' Alisa questions him with a thoughtful tilt of her head.
Я самый красивый повар в Москве!
'I am the most handsome chef in Moscow!' Viktor declares his boast with theatrical confidence.
Но мама говорит, ты очень смешной.
'But mom says you are very funny.' Alisa giggles as she shares her mother's teasing view.
Мама просто завидует моему таланту.
'Mom is simply jealous of my talent.' Viktor defends his dignity with amused flair.
Тогда давай играть дальше!
'Then let us keep playing!' Alisa cheers as she returns to their game with joy.
Я всегда готов играть с тобой.
